title: Add private beta workflow dry-run gate
summary: Add a local dry-run wrapper for the private beta workflow that runs preflight and scoped release/productization validation without publishing artifacts.
reason: Before dispatching the GitHub Actions beta workflow, operators need one repeatable command that proves the checked-in workflow, updater config generation, release tests, and Tauri scaffold checks still agree locally.
behavior_before: Operators could run individual preflight, artifact verifier, productization tests, and Tauri checks, but there was no single local dry-run gate for the beta workflow path.
behavior_after: Operators can run one local workflow dry-run command that uses placeholder release secrets only for local preflight, runs scoped Python release/productization tests, optionally runs Tauri cargo check, and reports structured JSON evidence.
manual_validation: Test-PrivateBetaWorkflowDryRun.ps1 full local dry-run - passed (preflight, 99 scoped tests, npm run check)
git diff --check targeted workflow dry-run files - passed
refresh_summaries targeted workflow dry-run paths - passed
validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - failed due unrelated MP-CHANGE-2026-0618-021 invalid type safety
rollback_plan: Remove the workflow dry-run script, tests, docs references, generated summaries, and this change packet.
notes: This is local release verification tooling only. Placeholder secrets used by the dry-run do not prove protected GitHub secrets exist and must not be used for publishing.
